body.name: continuous one-window-unit experiment
body.construction: \(\mathcal E_1\) has three one-unit blocks, \(W=\{2\}\), \(q_2=1\), deterministic control outside the window, and window probabilities \(p_{21}(z_0)=p_{\mathrm{floor}}\) and \(p_{21}(z_1)=1-p_{\mathrm{floor}}\); set \(D=\min\{\Gamma,2M\}\)
